name: Takato
source:
One of the four people with the special abilities from the Setou Underground Science Institution, a genius and a former university professor. Takato is the owner of a very calm and gentle personality, but he also has a past that keeps haunting him...

[Roughly translated from [url=http://cla.velvet.jp/kasou1.htm]the official site[/url].]
